<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OnlineShopPurchase" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-purchase">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopPurchase" name="Purchase items from an online shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderStarted" name="Order started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to account"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Order_Split" name="Split order steps"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose free reward option"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Split" name="Pay or complete installment agreement?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteInstallment" name="Complete installment agreement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Merge" name="Payment completed"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Order_Join" name="Order steps completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" name="Ready for delivery"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Return_Split" name="Return items for exchange?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PurchaseCompleted" name="Purchase completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderStarted" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Installment agreement" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_CompleteInstallment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CompleteInstallment" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_Return_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Items returned" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="No return" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_PurchaseCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
